name: Lightning-TS-TW
title: Lightning
description: One thin electric-blue bolt runs from top to bottom of a black stage, kinking and branching as it goes. The shape keeps re-forming, brightening and thinning like a live strike.
use: A dark page wants a single dramatic electric accent behind sparse content.
avoid: You need to fill a wide area: the bolt stays in a narrow vertical band.
a11y: Decorative and always flickering, with no reduced-motion check for users sensitive to flashes. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A single jagged vertical line of cool blue-white light on a black field, thicker where it forks and hairline-thin elsewhere. A soft glow bleeds a few pixels around the core, with the rest of the frame empty.
behaves: The bolt writhes continuously, splitting into new forks and changing thickness, while its overall brightness pulses. The path stays roughly vertical and never leaves the frame.
customise: Hue, horizontal offset, speed, intensity and scale are the only props. The fork logic and glow falloff are fixed in the shader.
weight: heavy: A full-screen fragment shader with a ten-octave noise stack runs every frame.
